# Shoaib — AI Solutions Architect

## Summary
Shoaib is a self-taught AI Solutions Architect based in Sialkot, Pakistan. He designs
and deploys "AI Workforces" — teams of specialized AI employees that run sales,
support, operations, reporting and internal workflows inside small and medium
businesses, deployed inside tools the business already owns (WhatsApp, CRM, POS, ERP).
Humans retain approval authority over every important decision the AI Workforce makes.

## Services
- AI Workforce systems for restaurants, ecommerce, schools, manufacturing, and healthcare
- Custom AI Workforces for other industries on request
- Two primary products: KhidmatAI (restaurant sales and operations) and SchoolOS
  (AI school management for private schools)

## Target markets
Pakistan, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar

## Positioning
Shoaib explicitly positions as an "AI Solutions Architect" rather than a chatbot or
automation-tool builder. His work is systems that compound in value over time, tied
to measurable business outcomes (revenue, cost, hours saved) rather than demos.

## Contact
Available via the diagnostic funnel on the site — a short questionnaire mapping where
a business is losing operational hours and whether an AI Workforce is the right fit.
